correctness.rationale: The path characteristic polynomial recurrence in characteristic two gives D_{2^r-1}(X)=X^{2^r-1}; one-dimensional kernel makes its entire path adjacency a single nilpotent Jordan block. In the cycle algebra z^n-1=(z^u-1)^h (u odd), only z=1 has zero cycle multiplier. At this root multiplication reduces, by a unit conjugacy, to a+s^2 on F[a,s]/(a^{q-1},s^h). For even h=2k its even/odd split consists of two copies of multiplication by a+w on F[a,w]/(a^{q-1},w^k). Frobenius bounds lengths, rank of (a+w)^{q-1} gives k-1 size-q blocks when k<q, or all k blocks of length k when k>=q; for h=1 the path block remains. Fitting decomposition supplies cumulative Q-powers and sharp entry times. Independently regenerated 284 direct grid adjacency power-rank comparisons. The algebraic block argument, not finite ranks, proves all r>=2,n>=3,char2 fields.
